en: A sepia-toned waterfront cityscape showing grand multi-story stone buildings along a broad boulevard beside a harbor. Several passenger boats are moored along the quay. The perspective looks down the length of the waterfront street lined with trees and vehicles, with a church spire visible in the distance. At the bottom right there is printed text identifying the location.
